results.label: Same finger bigrams
results.note: Two consecutive keys pressed by the same finger (repeats excluded).

results.label: SFB distance
results.note: Σ frequency × distance of same finger bigrams (percent-weighted key units).

results.label: SFB ≥ 2 rows
results.note: Same finger bigrams jumping over the home row.

results.label: Repeated keys
results.note: The same key pressed twice in a row.

results.label: Lateral stretch bigrams
results.note: Adjacent fingers ≥ 2U apart horizontally, or semi-adjacent fingers ≥ 3.5U apart.

results.label: Full scissor bigrams
results.note: Two rows apart with the finger that prefers being higher below the other (adjacent fingers weigh 1, others 0.5).

results.label: Half scissor bigrams
results.note: One row apart with the finger that prefers being higher below the other.

results.label: Thumb bigrams
results.note: Consecutive presses on the same hand where at least one key is a thumb key.

results.label: Thumb double taps
results.note: The same thumb key pressed twice in a row (harder than on other fingers).

results.label: Layer tap → same finger
results.note: A layer tap followed by another key on the same finger (e.g. two thumb taps).

results.label: Same finger skipgrams
results.note: Same finger with one key in between.

results.label: SFS (skip 1–3, weighted)
results.note: Same finger skipgrams over 1–3 keys weighted 0.5 / 0.25 / 0.125.

results.label: Finger movement (SFS distance)
results.note: Distance-weighted same finger skipgrams (Genkey/Oxeylyzer style finger speed component).

results.label: Alternation
results.note: Hand changes on every key (L R L / R L R), no thumb pressed.

results.label: Alternation with SFS
results.note: Alternating trigram whose outer keys share a finger.

results.label: Inward rolls
results.note: Two keys on one hand moving toward the index, then the other hand (or vice versa), no thumb pressed.

results.label: Rolls (in + out)
results.note: Two-key rolls on one hand plus a key on the other hand, no thumb pressed.

results.label: Redirects
results.note: One-handed trigram that changes direction.

results.label: Weak redirects
results.note: Redirects that do not involve an index finger.

results.label: Finger usage
results.note: Share of keystrokes per finger.

results.label: Hand balance
results.note: Share of keystrokes per hand (value = |left − right|).

results.label: Pinky off home
results.note: Keystrokes on top/bottom-row pinky keys.

results.label: Finger travel
results.note: Cumulative Euclidean travel from each finger's previous key (U per keystroke).

results.label: Effort
results.note: cyanophage's Effort: its per-key grid, 577 × effort ÷ keystrokes; a thumb press costs 1 and a space nothing (the grid is editable).

results.label: Hard words
results.note: Words ranked by effort per character (includes extra layer/shift presses).

results.label: Wasted one-shots
results.note: One-shot layers spent on a key that fell through to another layer, a modifier, another layer key or a key that does nothing.

results.label: Adaptive key hit rate
results.note: How often an adaptive key produced its trigger output rather than the default.

results.label: Extra keystrokes per symbol
results.note: Presses per symbol typed, minus one, the space bar left out: layer taps, holds and shifts add to it; a macro or combo typing several symbols takes from it.

results.label: Same-hand run length
results.note: Mean length of same-hand runs; histogram in breakdown.

results.label: Same-hand strings
results.note: Words/strings typed on one hand for ≥ 4 keys.

results.label: In:out roll ratio
results.note: Inward rolls divided by outward rolls.
